data.gender_notes: Mehul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mehul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mohan', which means 'moon'. The name signifies the shining moon and is often given to boys born during the lunar phase. It is a popular name in Hindu culture. The name Mehul carries the meaning “Shining Moon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mehul usually hope their child will grow to embody shining moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
